supported_scope: Python repositories of a few hundred files, facts-only mode, run by someone who can read the limits.
Detection of the nine planted defect classes in tests/fixtures/benchmarks, measured at recall 1.0 against a baseline of 0.125.
Reproducibility: the fact sets are byte-identical across runs of an unchanged tree.
unsupported_scope: Any claim about unseen repositories: every measured case is one this tool was developed against.
Usefulness to a reader: no independent person has judged a claim or a card.
The semantic arm: no model provider ran, so nothing is known about interpretation quality.
Comparison against a plain agent: never performed.
Languages other than Python beyond parsing; non-Python detection depth is unmeasured.
Repositories above a few thousand files: performance and precision at that size are unmeasured.
limits: This record exists to stop a pilot being described as a release. It supports the former only.
